primary_supplementary_group: Other-provider within-group price-change context and observed collector composition
minimum_peer_coverage: At least two other providers with same source, GPU model, instrument and tier, each return computed within an unchanged source/provider/SKU/region/node identity; minimum coverage applies to paired-return context, not unverified dollar comparability
strict_price_comparisons: Additional dollar-ratio fields require recorded nonmissing region and node-count agreement; otherwise remain null
target_definition: New source-specific provider/SKU/region/node daily observed-quote median, not a persistent marketplace listing or the official collector target
missing_identity: Unknown metadata remains explicit; same-timestamp conflicting quotes are excluded before model performance is observed
historical_limit: Frozen Pacific collection vintage and declared source timestamps; not independent proof of real-time historical publication
prior_v8: No offer replay or repeat pooled-change forecasting study; v8 negative findings and failed identity gates retained
prospective_limit: New current-source contracts retain separate IDs; transfer from historical source-defined groups is reported explicitly, never as exact identity with competition targets
